recheck.summary: Firefighters Credit Union / P&S Credit Union

fields.notes: Firefighters CU announced the merger on Oct 1, 2026. The Utah Department of Financial Institutions and NCUA have approved it; P&S members began voting Oct 1 (NCUA lists the vote for Nov 16, 2026), and if they approve, the merger takes effect Dec 1, 2026. Firefighters CU members don't vote. The P&S branch keeps the P&S name while operations are combined, which is expected to take up to a year.
fields.next_steps: P&S member vote (NCUA lists Nov 16, 2026; result not yet published); if approved, the merger takes effect Dec 1, 2026

recheck.summary: F&A Federal Credit Union / Ontario Public Employees Federal Credit Union

fields.partner: Ontario Public Employees Federal Credit Union
fields.notes: OPEFCU announced a signed letter of intent to merge with F&A in a Sep 30, 2026 member letter. Members vote at a Nov 24, 2026 special meeting in Ontario. If approved, OPEFCU members become F&A members on Mar 1, 2027 and accounts convert Mar 29, 2027; the OPEFCU name sunsets. All OPEFCU employees, including its CEO, join F&A, and F&A's board continues.

changes.new: Final approval from the California DFPI; the combination is expected to close Jan 1, 2027

changes.old: NCUA, CA DFPI and WA DFI approved Aug 4, 2026. The member vote closed Oct 27 at a special meeting; SAFE calls the support strong but has not released a tally. In November a group of SAFE members petitioned the CA DFPI to pause and review the merger, alleging inadequate disclosure and self-dealing (Credit Union Daily, Nov 16 and 18). As of Nov 22, SAFE's combination page says final approvals, including the CA DFPI's, have been received and that SAFE and BECU legally combine on Jan 1, 2027 (SAFE's vote page still says it awaits DFPI approval).
changes.new: NCUA, CA DFPI and WA DFI approved Aug 4, 2026. The member vote closed Oct 27 at a special meeting; SAFE calls the support strong but has not released a tally.
